root: ^I’m a bounty hunter. I don’t pick sides.
^Please, you cannot do this. Talon is shipping illegal supplies through this trade route.
^If we blow it up, that would cripple Talon’s defenses. You have to help me.
^I worked for Talon in the past, and now he’s kidnapped my daughter. You can’t trust him.
^He’ll continue to force you to do tasks for him and if you stop he’ll take everything away from you.
^Double Talon’s bounty and I’ll do it.
^We need to head to Talon’s main base.
^That’s where he’s holding my daughter, and we should also be able to defeat Talon there too.
